items.text: About 1,800 Hydra polyps of twelve cohorts, each polyp in its own glass dish, followed for almost ten years, 3.9 million Hydra-days in all, die at about 0.6 per cent a year at each age, and their reproduction is at one level across age. In the cold-sensitive strain of Hydra oligactis, the ageing animals' epithelial stem cells are deficient in autophagy.

items.text: Kuru spread among the Fore of Papua New Guinea through eating their dead at funerals, some 200 people dying of it each year at its height. The Fore stopped the practice, and kuru went on some five decades more, its incubation averaging 10 to 13 years and reaching 50 years and more. Bovine spongiform encephalopathy spread among cattle fed meat-and-bone meal made from cattle.

items.sentence: It has no code at all — it is a protein misfolding to one shape, and it propagates by pressing selves it meets to one same misfold.
items.text: Among more than 3,000 people of the Eastern Highlands, 709 of them at mortuary feasts and 152 of those later dead of kuru, the prion protein variant G127V is common where kuru's incidence is highest and absent from kuru patients and from unexposed populations. Mice making human prion protein of the common form and the V127 form together resist kuru and classical CJD prions, and mice with V127 alone resist each prion strain tested. The prions leave the V127 protein at its own fold, and the V127 protein slows, by its dose, the spreading of the common form's misfold.

items.text: Identical twinning is 3 to 4 pairs in each thousand births, near one rate across the world, across the years and across maternal age, and identical twins seldom cluster in families. Twin births range from under 10 to up to 30 in each thousand deliveries across the world's regions, and fraternal twinning runs in families, rises with maternal age and with a mother's prior births, and goes with gene variants near FSHB and in SMAD3. items.section: 5.5 Multicellularity and the germ-soma split — many selves into one; the self going on and the sharing surface
items.sentence: And snowflake yeast, under selection for larger clusters, turns tetraploid within fifty days, a genome doubling with each cell as a cluster grows to a larger scale.
items.text: Across 10 replicate populations, snowflake yeast goes on tetraploid some 950 days past its first fifty, about 5,000 generations. Haploid baker's yeast evolving in bioreactors, two lines of fewer than 500 generations each, forms multicellular, fast-sedimenting clusters, each line with a whole-genome doubling and its own frameshift mutation in a run of eight adenosines in ACE2, a gene of mother-daughter cell separation. The two mutant alleles in the haploid parent give only slow-sedimenting clusters of a few cells, and a diploid made with two mutant ace2 alleles gives the whole phenotype.

items.section: 7.2 Ageing — the sway no longer coming round again
items.sentence: A tree goes on with outer rings where conducting goes on; its ageing is with joins that stop and do not restore, and it ages unevenly because joins stop one at a time.
items.text: A tree's sapwood moves water from root to leaf through tracheids and vessel elements dead at maturity, their living contents gone, the water passing through the emptied cells. Heartwood forms from sapwood by a process the field names genetically programmed, and a tree can thrive with its heart wholly decayed.

A biofilm of microbes, mucus and immune molecules lines the bowel, most pronounced in the appendix.
